test_title: PYST 27: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 17 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All rabbits are squirrel.

Some squirrels are rats.

All rats are mammals.

Conclusions:

(I) Some mammals are squirrel.

(II) Some rats are rabbits
solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16b7b15b5a7a0a5a9488fb33f3be593674ae85e125556e071fbba006c2bbec44.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some mammals are squirrel → **True **(As, Some squirrels are rats, All rats are mammals. so, Some mammals are squirrel holds true)

(II) Some rats are rabbits → False (As, there is no direct relation between rats and rabbits. so, some rats are rabbits can be a possibility but definite).

Thus, Only conclusion (I) follows.

Hence, the corrrect answer is **"Option 1".**
